holds_one_liner: Ministerial related-case order. Judge Breyer finds Brendan Ngwa Nforbi v. Meza-Gonzalez (26-cv-08271, formerly AMO) related to Ngehsi Newanforbi v. Serrato and reassigns it to himself. Future filings bear CRB (4:26-cv-08271-CRB). Noticed motion dates are vacated and must be re-noticed. ADR and case-management-order deadlines continue, except court appearance dates.
